pipeline.why_it_matters: sel-06 (2026-11-11): the pass renders through the same product_picture.build the API calls, so the number describes the product. The plate is named above: when it is 'drawn' the picture's photograph is a stand-in and only the artwork, warp and gate are real.

matte_residue_audit.note: The published mean was scored before the background was measured off the corners; the 12 full-generation artefacts re-scored with the residue check are 8 checked, 8 failed, residue 10.2-25.6% of the frame, mean 90.0. The other 20 artefacts are drawn-plate product_picture outputs whose silhouette includes the plate shadow, so the check cannot see it there (D-021). The published mean is provisional until a re-render on the fixed routes.

ceiling.note: the published mean is over generated/composite outputs. Only 12 of 56 briefs have a reference on disk that can be cut out and verified; the other 44 cannot be produced honestly here (32 prompt-only, 12 with no local reference copy). Counting those as zero would be a pipeline verdict on evidence that does not exist; counting them as passes would be invention.
